task_instance: Convert a raw voice-dictation transcript describing a CSV export bug on a reporting dashboard into a structured GitHub-flavored markdown issue file, saved as /issues/YYYY-MM-DD-short-description.md per the skill's Output Location and Output Template.
evidence: Created raw_input.txt containing a messy voice-dictation transcript about a CSV export bug. Extracted structure from the chaotic text and wrote issues/2026-09-27-csv-export-hangs-on-dashboard.md following the skill's exact template (Summary, Environment, Reproduction Steps, Expected/Actual Behavior, Error Details, Visual Evidence, Impact, Additional Context). Applied guidelines: placeholdered the unnamed project as [PROJECT_NAME], assigned Impact severity 'High' per the Critical/High/Medium/Low rubric (major feature broken, blocking a deadline, no workaround), and used the YYYY-MM-DD-short-description.md naming convention. Verified via `ls issues/` (file present) and `grep -E "^## "` confirming all 9 required template headings are present in order, and `wc -l` showing a populated 35-line file. The skill's core deliverable (raw notes -> structured markdown issue file on disk) requires no GitHub API, network access, or credentials -- it is purely a local file-authoring task -- so it was fully achievable and verified end-to-end in the sandbox.
